title: fix(fields): localize relative-date humanize to the workspace locale (framework#3040)
body:
Fixes objectstack-ai/framework#3040

## Problem

Date fields' ±7-day relative window (`formatRelativeDate` in `@object-ui/fields`) hardcoded English — Today / Tomorrow / Yesterday / In 3 days / 2d ago / Overdue 2d — regardless of the workspace `localization.locale` (ADR-0053). All three surfaces (list columns, detail header chips, detail body) render through the same `DateCellRenderer`.

## Fix

- Generic near-today phrases now come from `Intl.RelativeTimeFormat(locale, { numeric: 'auto' })` (sentence-cased) — zh-CN yields 今天/明天/昨天/3天前/3天后 with no bundle maintenance per locale. Invalid locale tags degrade to English instead of crashing the cell.
- The tenant locale is threaded from `useLocalization()` (ADR-0053 client half) through `DateCellRenderer` into `formatDate`/`formatRelativeDate` via a new `DateDisplayOptions` bag; the absolute (>7d) path also formats with that locale.
- "Overdue Nd" has no `Intl` equivalent, so it resolves through the i18n key `fields.relativeDate.overdue` (added to all 10 built-in locale files; zh: `逾期 {{count}} 天`), with the English literal as fallback when the key misses or no i18n context is mounted.
- Intentional English change: `3d ago` → `3 days ago` (Intl output).

## Tests

`pnpm exec vitest run packages/fields/src/__tests__/DateCellRenderer.test.tsx` — 8/8 (new: zh-CN window phrases, overdue via t(), t-miss fallback, invalid-locale degradation).

Server-side half of this issue pair (audit summary i18n, #3039): objectstack-ai/framework#3045.
